fields.cover_headline:
Replaced by AI.
Then asked to {o:come back}.
fields.step1_body:
32% of US hiring managers say they brought back
roles they'd cut for AI.
Top reason: knowledge AI couldn't replace.
The free Skill Finder shows what yours is worth.
fields.step2_body:
Who walked over to your desk, and for what?
List five things people asked you to fix.
Those are problems you already solve.
But which one would someone pay for?
fields.step3_heading: Find who pays for it {b:outside} a job
fields.step3_body:
Small businesses. People just starting out.
The person you were 20 years ago.
Ask ChatGPT: who pays to fix this, and how?
Then check it with real people first.
fields.step4_heading: Test it before you {o:spend} a dollar
fields.step4_body:
Ask three people about the last time
they had this problem. What did they do?
What did it cost them?
Their answers tell you if it can pay you.
fields.cta_subtext: Comment {o:SKILLS} and I'll DM you my free Skill Finder: 12 questions, then AI names your 3 most sellable skills.
